+## Mission
+

+
+## Delivered behavior
+
+- **Single is the default.** Three visible toggles and the header identify Single, Mode A (Draft), and Mode B.
+- **Mode A runs separate models.** Mode B combines XML with node offsets, downloads XML/map, then loads the result into **Single**; it has no separate conversion path.
+- Typed Weight Match edits use the existing manual Final authority. Candidate selections retain Match-1 provenance validation. Bulk suggestion fill preserves existing entries; Single review keeps proposed values visible for Apply.
+- The existing active Python runtime preserves weighted negative sentinels, their actual source start points and physical short hops. The guard matches original source identity and exact mass; it still blocks missing/zero-length/invalid/ambiguous owners.
+- Source/docs and the reverse import cache chain are activated together. No runtime/writer/canvas ownership switch, engineering master/formula/unit change, or workflow edit.

+## Independent acceptance
+
+Native Chrome + deployed docs mirror + actual Pyodide, with XML and CII downloads:
+
+| Workflow | Result |
+| --- | --- |
+| Owner's SYS-6-S8810010-01.xml + SYS-6-S8810011-01.xml + SYS-S8811956-01.xml | 7 branches, 452 source nodes; offsets 0/100000/200000; combined XML loads into Single; **42/42** physical weighted CII owners |

+| Mode B deep comparison | 82 branches/3308 nodes; all non-number fields retained; malformed/mixed-unit/overflow/zero-step inputs rejected |

Existing six-significant-digit CII serialization and selected x10 Run convention are unchanged. +Focused gates: **28/28 main**, **25/25 dataset**, **38/38 mission**; native CLI physical fixtures and fail-closed guards PASS. Single and Mode A canvas latest-output refresh verified.

+## Recovery / boundaries

+"""Reconcile every changed path and mirror against live main; reject scope leaks."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+import subprocess
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+folder = Path(__file__).parent
+def git(*args):
+    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+base = git('rev-parse', 'origin/main').decode().strip()
+changed = set(git('diff', '--name-only', 'origin/main').decode().splitlines())
+changed.update(git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines())
+protected = [p for p in changed if p == 'README.md' or p.startswith(('Benchmarks/', 'ValidationRecords/', '.github/workflows/'))]
+assert not protected, protected
+assert all(p.startswith(('agents/', '.backups/', 'converters/', 'core/', 'docs/', 'tabs/', 'tests/'))
+           or p in ['index.html', 'main-rhbg-fitguard.js'] for p in changed), sorted(changed)
+rows = []
+mirrors = []
+cache = re.compile(r'\?v=[^\s\'"\)<>]+')
+for path in sorted(changed):
+    file = ROOT / path
+    if not file.exists():
+        rows.append({'path': path, 'reason': 'WIP identity migrated after allocation', 'kind': 'handover'})
+        continue
+    data = file.read_bytes()
+    if path.startswith('agents/'):
+        reason, kind = 'recovery, actual acceptance evidence, live claim/status reconciliation', 'handover/evidence'
+    elif path.startswith('.backups/'):
+        reason, kind = 'mandatory native backup ledger', 'backup'
+    elif path.startswith('tests/'):
+        reason, kind = 'physical owner, manual weight, mode dispatch, or activated release contract regression', 'validation'
+    else:
+        result = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', 'origin/main:' + path], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True)
+        before = result.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').replace('\r\n', '\n')
+        after = data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').replace('\r\n', '\n')
+        metadata = cache.sub('', before) == cache.sub('', after)
+        reason = 'reverse import query activation only' if metadata else 'bounded mode, review, physical-owner repair; existing ownership retained'
+        kind = 'cache-only' if metadata else 'implementation'
+        if path.startswith('docs/'):
+            source = ROOT / path[5:]
+            assert source.exists() and source.read_bytes() == data, 'Source/docs byte drift: ' + path
+            mirrors.append(path)
+            reason = 'exact source mirror: ' + reason
+    rows.append({'path': path, 'kind': kind, 'reason': reason, 'bytes': len(data),
+                 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
+    if path.endswith('/changed-file-ledger.json'):
+        rows[-1]['bytes'] = None
+        rows[-1]['sha256'] = 'SELF_REFERENTIAL_NOT_HASHED'
+report = {'baseMain': base, 'head': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip(),
+          'protectedPathDiff': protected, 'exactMirrors': len(mirrors), 'changed': rows}
+(folder / 'changed-file-ledger.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
+summary = {kind: sum(row['kind'] == kind for row in rows) for kind in sorted({row['kind'] for row in rows})}
+print(json.dumps({'status': 'PASS', 'paths': len(rows), 'mirrors': len(mirrors), 'classes': summary}))

+"""Replay unchanged existing gate and mission regressions, with durable commands."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+folder = Path(__file__).parent
+workflow = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/issue-776-validation.yml").read_text()
+focused = workflow.split("Run Issue 776 focused regressions", 1)[1].split("status=${PIPESTATUS", 1)[0]
+dataset = workflow.split("Run PR780 master dataset regressions", 1)[1].split("status=${PIPESTATUS", 1)[0]
+predecessor = json.loads((ROOT / "agents/evidence/WIP-781-OUTPUT-CUSTODY-20261001/validation-commands.json").read_text())
+commands = {
+    "unchanged-main-focused": ["node", "--test", *re.findall(r"tests/[^\s\\]+\.mjs", focused)],
+    "dataset-custody": ["node", "--test", *re.findall(r"tests/[^\s\\]+\.mjs", dataset)],
+    "mission-focused": [*predecessor['focusedNodeCommand'].split(), "tests/xml-cii-processing-mode.test.mjs", "tests/xml-cii-issue-781-weight-match-authority-presentation.test.mjs"],

+    "publication-guard": [sys.executable, "tests/xml-cii-weight-owner-guard.test.py"],
+}
+results = []
+for label, command in commands.items():
+    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+    (folder / (label + ".log")).write_text(result.stdout + result.stderr, encoding="utf-8")
+    row = {"label": label, "command": command, "exitCode": result.returncode,
+           "status": "PASS" if result.returncode == 0 else "FAIL", "observation": "EXECUTION",
+           "oracle": "EXISTING_GATE_PLUS_INDEPENDENT_PHYSICAL_FIXTURES"}
+    results.append(row)
+    print(json.dumps({key: row[key] for key in ['label', 'exitCode', 'status']}), flush=True)
+(folder / "focused-validation.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + "\n")
+sys.exit(1 if any(row['status'] == 'FAIL' for row in results) else 0)

+"""Preserve source weighted components within the existing standalone model."""
+import math
+import sys
+
+
+def _text(element, name):
+    return next((child.text or "" for child in element
+                 if child.tag.split("}")[-1] == name), "").strip()
+
+
+def _has_weight(element):
+    weight = float(_text(element, "Weight") or "0")
+    return _text(element, "Rigid") == "2" and math.isfinite(weight) and weight > 0
+
+
+def prepare_weighted_node_numbers(root):
+    """Allocate IDs only for weighted sentinels and their actual predecessor."""
+    elements = [node for node in root.iter() if node.tag.split("}")[-1] == "Node"]
+    numbers = [int(_text(node, "NodeNumber")) for node in elements if _text(node, "NodeNumber")]
+    next_number = max([0, *numbers]) + 10
+    source_numbers = {}
+    predecessors = set()
+    for branch in root.iter():
+        if branch.tag.split("}")[-1] != "Branch":
+            continue
+        nodes = [node for node in branch if node.tag.split("}")[-1] == "Node"]
+        needed = {i for i, node in enumerate(nodes) if _has_weight(node)}
+        predecessors.update(id(nodes[i - 1]) for i in needed if i > 0)
+        needed |= {i - 1 for i in needed if i > 0}
+        for index in sorted(needed):
+            node = nodes[index]
+            number = int(_text(node, "NodeNumber"))
+            if number > 0:
+                continue
+            source_numbers[id(node)] = number
+            field = next(child for child in node if child.tag.split("}")[-1] == "NodeNumber")
+            field.text = str(next_number)
+            print(f"WEIGHT_COMPONENT_NODE_ID branch={_text(branch, 'Branchname')} "
+                  f"source_node={number} runtime_node={next_number} reference={_text(node, 'ComponentRefNo')}", file=sys.stderr)
+            next_number += 10
+    return source_numbers, predecessors
+
+
+def preserve_weighted_short_hop(kept, node, protected, length):
+    """Keep nonzero physical component hops; never shift or sum their mass."""
+    previous = kept[-1]
+    arriving_weighted = node.rigid == 2 and math.isfinite(node.weight) and node.weight > 0
+    previous_weighted = previous.rigid == 2 and math.isfinite(previous.weight) and previous.weight > 0
+    if (arriving_weighted or node.weighted_component_start) and length > 0:
+        return [*kept, node]
+    if previous_weighted and not arriving_weighted and node.node_number in protected and length > 0:
+        return [*kept, node]
+    return None

+"""Audit downloaded XML/CII using source physical deltas, independent of parser cleanup.
+
+No converter imports. Each positive Rigid=2 weight requires its actual preceding
+source endpoint. CII element/rigid records must reproduce the resulting multiset.
+The selected UI x10 convention and CII X,Z,-Y axes are explicit oracle inputs.
+"""
+from collections import Counter
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+folder = Path(sys.argv[1])
+scale = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 10.0
+root = ET.parse(folder / "ui-run.xml").getroot()
+for element in root.iter():
+    element.tag = element.tag.split("}")[-1]
+expected = []
+by_key = {}
+for branch in root.iter("Branch"):
+    name = branch.findtext("Branchname").strip()
+    nodes = branch.findall("Node")
+    for index, node in enumerate(nodes):
+        number = int(node.findtext("NodeNumber"))
+        point = tuple(map(float, node.findtext("Position").split()))
+        weight = float(node.findtext("Weight") or 0)
+        descriptor = "|".join((node.findtext(tag) or "").strip() for tag in
+                              ["ComponentRefNo", "Endpoint", "Position", "ComponentType"]
+                              if (node.findtext(tag) or "").strip())
+        by_key[name + "::" + (str(number) if number > 0 else descriptor)] = weight
+        by_key[name + "::" + descriptor] = weight
+        if node.findtext("Rigid") != "2" or weight <= 0:
+            continue
+        assert index > 0, f"Missing source predecessor {name}::{number}"
+        before = tuple(map(float, nodes[index - 1].findtext("Position").split()))
+        delta = tuple(right - left for left, right in zip(before, point))
+        assert math.dist(before, point) > 0, f"Zero-length weighted component {name}::{number}"
+        expected.append((name, delta[0], delta[2], -delta[1], weight * scale))
+
+cii = (folder / "ui-run.cii").read_text()
+def section(name):
+    return [line for line in cii.split("#$ " + name + "\n", 1)[1].split("#$", 1)[0].splitlines() if line.strip()]
+
+rigid = [float(line.split()[0]) for line in section("RIGID")]
+elements = section("ELEMENTS")
+assert len(elements) % 15 == 0
+observed = []
+for index in range(0, len(elements), 15):
+    block = elements[index:index + 15]
+    numbers = [float(block[0][start:end]) for start, end in [(0, 15), (15, 28), (28, 41), (41, 54), (54, 67), (67, 80)]]
+    rigid_index = int(block[12].split()[1])
+    if rigid_index <= 0 or rigid[rigid_index - 1] <= 0:
+        continue
+    branch = block[10].strip().split(" ", 1)[1].strip()
+    observed.append((branch, *numbers[2:5], rigid[rigid_index - 1]))
+
+# CII stores six significant digits. Compare each independent expected value
+# after that defined serialization rounding, without relaxing engineering units.
+def serialized(row):
+    return (row[0], *(float(f"{value:.6g}") for value in row[1:]))
+
+differences = {
+    "missing": list((Counter(map(serialized, expected)) - Counter(map(serialized, observed))).elements()),
+    "extra": list((Counter(map(serialized, observed)) - Counter(map(serialized, expected))).elements())}
+if differences['missing'] or differences['extra']:
+    (folder / "physical-weight-audit-failure.json").write_text(json.dumps({"status": "FAIL",
+        "observation": "DOWNLOADED_ARTIFACT_INSPECTION", "oracle": "INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_PHYSICAL_ENDPOINTS_AND_ENTERED_MASSES",
+        **differences}, indent=2) + "\n")
+    raise AssertionError(differences)
+accepted_path = folder / "review-accepted.json"
+accepted = json.loads(accepted_path.read_text()) if accepted_path.exists() else []
+for item in accepted:
+    assert abs(by_key[item["key"]] - item["weight"]) <= 1e-9, item
+report = {"status": "PASS", "observation": "DOWNLOADED_ARTIFACT_INSPECTION",
+          "oracle": "INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_PHYSICAL_ENDPOINTS_AND_ENTERED_MASSES",
+          "weightedSourceComponents": len(expected), "positiveCiiOwners": len(observed),
+          "reviewedWeights": len(accepted), "scale": scale,
+          "sourceGeometry": "actual immediate predecessor, including negative IDs",
+          "serialization": "CII six significant digits", "converterImported": False}
+(folder / "physical-weight-audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
+print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

+"""Independent physical endpoints and weights through the active CLI and guard."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "converters/scripts"))
+import xml_to_cii2019 as base
+import xml_to_cii2019_runtime_custody as runtime
+import xml_to_cii2019_patched as patched
+from xml_cii_weight_output_custody import require_rigid_weight_owners
+
+
+def node(number, x, weight=0, component="PIPE", ref=None):
+    return (f"<Node><NodeNumber>{number}</NodeNumber><Position>{x} 0 0</Position>"
+            f"<Endpoint>2</Endpoint><ComponentType>{component}</ComponentType>"
+            f"<ComponentRefNo>{ref or 'REF'+str(number)}</ComponentRefNo>"
+            f"<Rigid>{2 if weight else 0}</Rigid><Weight>{weight}</Weight></Node>")
+
+
+def branch(name, nodes):
+    return f"<Pipe><Branch><Branchname>{name}</Branchname>{nodes}</Branch></Pipe>"
+
+
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+    folder = Path(directory)
+    source = folder / "source.xml"
+    source.write_text("<PipeStressExport xmlns='http://aveva.com/pipeStress116.xsd'>"
+        + branch("/HEAD", node(-1, 0) + node(20, 89, 59, "RIGID") + node(30, 200))
+        + branch("/SHORT", node(100, 0) + node(110, 1, 13.5, "FLAN") + node(120, 100))
+        + branch("/SENTINEL", node(200, 0) + node(-1, 100, 378, "VALV", "V1")
+                 + node(-1, 200, 303.967, "FLAN", "F1") + node(210, 300))
+        + branch("/JUNCTION", node(300, 0) + node(309, 86, 17.75, "FLAN") + node(310, 89) + node(320, 200))
+        + branch("/PEER", node(310, 89) + node(400, 300))
+        + branch("/START", node(500, 0) + node(510, 3.2) + node(-1, 613.2, 365, "VALV", "VS"))
+        + "</PipeStressExport>", encoding="utf-8")
+    document = base._parse_xml_document(source)
+    model = patched._build_conversion_model(document, {}, {}, {})
+    require_rigid_weight_owners(source, model)
+    expected = [("/HEAD", 0, 89, 59), ("/SHORT", 0, 1, 13.5),
+                ("/SENTINEL", 0, 100, 378), ("/SENTINEL", 100, 200, 303.967),
+                ("/JUNCTION", 0, 86, 17.75), ("/START", 3.2, 613.2, 365)]
+    observed = [(edge.branch_name, edge.from_node.position[0], edge.to_node.position[0], edge.to_node.weight)
+                for edge in model.rigid_edges if edge.to_node.weight > 0]
+    assert observed == expected, observed
+    assert model.degrees[310] == 3, "Shared source junction must remain connected"
+    assert any(edge.from_node.node_number == 309 and edge.to_node.node_number == 310
+               and edge.to_node.position[0] - edge.from_node.position[0] == 3 for edge in model.edges)
+    sentinels = [n for b in document.branches for n in b.nodes if n.source_node_number == -1]
+    assert len(sentinels) == 4 and len({n.node_number for n in sentinels}) == 4
+    assert min(n.node_number for n in sentinels) > 510
+    output = folder / "result.cii"
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "converters/scripts/xml_to_cii2019_runtime_custody.py"),
+                    "--input", str(source), "--output", str(output), "--weight-scale", "10"],
+                   check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
+    payload = output.read_text().split("#$ RIGID", 1)[1].split("#$", 1)[0]
+    weights = [float(row.split()[0]) for row in payload.splitlines() if row.strip()]
+    assert weights == [590, 135, 3780, 3039.67, 177.5, 3650], weights
+    # The optional preservation policy cannot alter other parser entry points.
+    legacy = runtime._ORIGINAL_PARSE_XML_DOCUMENT(source)
+    assert all(n.node_number > 0 and n.source_node_number is None for b in legacy.branches for n in b.nodes)
+    assert len(legacy.branches[0].nodes) == 2
+
+print("PASS: actual negative predecessors, distinct sentinel owners, 1mm weighted component, 3mm junction hop, CLI masses")
